routes.label: Use nonnegativity and check the other choices

question: Which of the following equations does not have a solution?
solution:
An absolute value is nonnegative. Therefore, for every real \(x\),
\[
|-3x|+5\ge 5>0.
\]
Thus the equation in B cannot have a solution.

To verify that it is the only such choice, one working value for each remaining equation is enough:
\[
\begin{aligned}
\text{A: }&x=-7, &&(-7+7)^2=0;\\
\text{C: }&x=-4, &&\sqrt{-(-4)}-2=0;\\
\text{D: }&x=64, &&\sqrt{64}-8=0;\\
\text{E: }&x=\frac43, &&\left|-3\left(\frac43\right)\right|-4=0.
\end{aligned}
\]
The square roots used here have nonnegative radicands. Hence the equation without a solution is \(|-3x|+5=0\), choice B.
